Real output of Scry's Lean v4.34.1 exporter in statement mode (`--statement-probes`).

- `probe_*.json`: from `tests/fixtures/lean/v4_34/Probes.lean`, written for these tests.
- `truffet_challenge.json`: from `lean/ComparatorChallenges/TruffetCounterexample.lean` in
  OpenAI's mathematics repository (https://github.com/openai/math), used under its
  Apache-2.0 license.
